h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dehradun

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dehradun

items.pText: Dehradun, the capital of Uttarakhand, lies in the Doon valley between the Shivalik hills and the Himalayan foothills. It is known for its residential schools, and many of them have large, green campuses. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Dehradun's schools, housing societies, hotels and parks. We make it at our factory in Vasai, about 1,320 km away, and send it by road.

A residential school's playground is used every day, morning and evening, by children who live on campus. It needs equipment with real challenge for older children, and enough variety to stay interesting through the year. Dehradun's monsoon is heavy, and winters are cold and damp. Larger play towers, climbing structures and wooden designs from our NexLev series suit campuses with space to spare. Day schools and housing societies in the city usually have less room, and for them a compact multi play system from CoreCraft is the more practical choice. We send a layout drawing either way, with the safe play area marked around every piece.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Many Dehradun campuses sit on sloping ground. Rather than levelling a whole hillside, we can place equipment on terraces, each with its own level base and drainage. Keep paths between terraces wide and well lit.

items.q: Can playground equipment go on sloping ground?
items.a: Yes, on terraces. Each terrace gets its own level base, drainage and rubber flooring. We plan the layout from site photos and rough levels of the slope.

items.q: What equipment suits a residential school?
items.a: Larger play towers and climbing structures for older children, with a separate set of lower pieces for juniors. Our NexLev range includes towers and wooden designs for big campuses.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Dehradun?
items.a: Yes. Equipment is made at our Vasai factory and sent by road. Our team or a dealer serving Uttarakhand installs it, grouted or self-standing.
